column1: 我|wo3|I; me|Notice the slanting hook and crossing strokes in 我.|我们|wo3 men5|we; us|我们一起画一张地图。|We draw a map together.|自我|zi4 wo3|self; oneself|这张卡片上写着我的自我介绍。|This card has my self-introduction on it.

你|ni3|you|Notice the narrow 亻 on the left of 你.|你好|ni3 hao3|hello|见到新朋友，我先说你好。|When I meet a new friend, I say hello first.|你们|ni3 men5|you (more than one person)|你们想坐在树下吗？|Would you like to sit under the tree?

他|ta1|he; him; other|Find 亻 on the left and 也 on the right of 他.|他人|ta1 ren2|other people|我们玩游戏时，也要照顾他人。|When we play games, we also look after other people.|其他|qi2 ta1|other; the rest|其他小朋友在桌边画画。|The other children are drawing at the table.

她|ta1|she; her|Compare the left side 女 in 她 with the left side of 他.|她们|ta1 men5|they (female people)|她们一起把纸花贴好。|They stick the paper flowers in place together.|她自己|ta1 zi4 ji3|she herself|她自己把书包收拾好了。|She packs her school bag herself.

它|ta1|it|Notice the roof-shaped 宀 at the top of 它.|它们|ta1 men5|they (things or animals)|两只小鸭来了，它们在水里游。|Two ducklings arrive; they swim in the water.|它自己|ta1 zi4 ji3|it itself|小猫醒了，它自己走到门口。|The kitten wakes up and walks to the doorway by itself.

们|men5|plural marker for people and pronouns|Find 亻 beside the door-shaped 门 in 们.|我们|wo3 men5|we; us|我们给小树浇水。|We water the little tree.|他们|ta1 men5|they; them|他们把积木放回盒子里。|They put the blocks back into the box.

的|de5|possessive or describing particle|Notice 白 on the left of 的; practise 的 in a whole phrase.|我的|wo3 de5|my; mine|这是我的书。|This is my book.|你的|ni3 de5|your; yours|你的雨伞放在门边。|Your umbrella is beside the door.

是|shi4|be; is; are|Notice 日 at the top and the long lower stroke of 是.|可是|ke3 shi4|but; however|我想出去玩，可是外面下雨了。|I want to play outside, but it is raining.|于是|yu2 shi4|so; thereupon|小猫找到了垫子，于是躺下休息。|The kitten finds a cushion, so it lies down to rest.
有|you3|have; there is|Notice the crossing top strokes above 月 in 有.|有用|you3 yong4|useful|这把小尺子很有用。|This little ruler is useful.|所有|suo3 you3|all|所有小朋友都拿到了一张纸。|All the children get a sheet of paper.

不|bu4|not; no|Notice the top horizontal stroke and the two spreading strokes in 不.|不会|bu4 hui4|cannot; have not learned how|我还不会打这个结，请你教我。|I cannot tie this knot yet; please teach me.|不行|bu4 xing2|not possible; will not do|这根绳子太短了，用它不行。|This string is too short; it will not do.

在|zai4|at; located at; action in progress|Find 土 at the lower right of 在.|现在|xian4 zai4|now|现在我们把桌子收拾好。|Now we tidy the table.|在场|zai4 chang3|be present|表演开始时，老师也在场。|The teacher is also present when the performance starts.

这|zhe4|this; these|Follow the long bottom stroke of 辶 in 这.|这个|zhe4 ge5|this one|这个盒子里装着铅笔。|This box holds pencils.|这样|zhe4 yang4|like this; this way|把纸这样折，就能做出一只小船。|Fold the paper this way to make a little boat.
那|na4|that; those|Notice the right-hand 阝 in 那.|那个|na4 ge5|that one|那个书包挂在椅子上。|That school bag hangs on the chair.|那样|na4 yang4|like that; that kind|我也想做一个那样的风筝。|I want to make a kite like that too.
哪|na3|which; where in question words|Find 口 beside 那 in 哪.|哪里|na3 li3|where|你把水杯放在哪里了？|Where did you put the drinking cup?|哪个|na3 ge5|which one|你想选哪个颜色？|Which colour would you like to choose?

谁|shei2|who|Find 讠 on the left of 谁; the selected reading here is shéi.|谁知|shei2 zhi1|who would have thought|我以为盒子空了，谁知里面还有积木。|I thought the box was empty; who would have thought there were still blocks inside?|谁的|shei2 de5|whose|这是谁的雨伞？|Whose umbrella is this?
什|shen2|what, in 什么|Notice 亻 beside 十 in 什; use shén in 什么.|什么|shen2 me5|what|你想画什么？|What would you like to draw?|为什么|wei4 shen2 me5|why|为什么小猫躲在桌子下面？|Why is the kitten hiding under the table?

么|me5|suffix in question words|Notice the small bent shape at the bottom of 么; practise it in a whole word.|那么|na4 me5|in that case; so|雨停了，那么我们去公园吧。|The rain has stopped; in that case, let us go to the park.|怎么|zen3 me5|how|这个纸盒怎么打开？|How do we open this paper box?

怎|zen3|how|Notice 心 below the top part of 怎.|怎么|zen3 me5|how|我们怎么把纸船放进水里？|How do we put the paper boat into the water?|怎样|zen3 yang4|how; in what way|怎样折纸才能做出一个小盒子？|How can we fold paper to make a little box?

为|wei4|for; because of|Notice the crossing strokes in 为; these words use wèi.|因为|yin1 wei4|because|因为下雨，我们在屋里看书。|Because it is raining, we read indoors.|为了|wei4 le5|in order to; for|为了不吓到小鸟，我们站得远一点。|To avoid frightening the little bird, we stand a little farther away.

和|he2|and; together with; make peace|Find 禾 beside 口 in 和; these words use hé.|和平|he2 ping2|peace|故事里的村子终于迎来了和平。|The village in the story finally welcomes peace.|和好|he2 hao3|make up; become friends again|两个朋友说清楚以后，就和好了。|After the two friends talk things through, they make up.
